trigger.reason: No immutable request id or whole-second trigger timestamp was available; deterministic source/mechanism regression remained permitted.

problem: The authenticated WebSocket PTY verified a Clerk JWT only at initial attach, so a long-lived PTY attachment had no explicit lease tied to the verified token exp claim.
delta: Validate exp as finite and future before the PTY attach is admitted.
Bound the live receive loop to the current token expiration using asyncio.wait_for.
Allow a bounded reauth control envelope and verify every refreshed JWT through the same ClerkTokenVerifier.
Fence refreshes to the originally authenticated Clerk sub and sid.
Force a fresh browser session token before expiry and reschedule from the verified refreshed exp.
Serialize concurrent WebSocket output frames with a send lock.
Preserve the already-fused 65536-byte browser PTY input chunking and ordinary 4096-character control bound.

primary_dependency_evidence.observed_contract: Validate session token authenticity and temporal claims including exp/nbf; authorized party validation remains required.
Client-side getToken({skipCache:true}) forces a newly minted session token.
Clerk session tokens are intentionally short-lived and frontend SDKs refresh them to preserve session continuity.

isolated_execution.network_note: PyPI DNS was unavailable; no dependency downloads were used for this regression.
isolated_execution.scope_limit: Focused helper and source-bound mechanism regression. Internal ClayVerse imports were minimally stubbed for the focused helper test. This is not a full repository suite, live Clerk browser/JWT test, OCI runtime test, or whole-product acceptance run.

adversarial_review.rejected_intermediate_change: Awaiting gather() on a cancelled asyncio.to_thread(os.read(...)) PTY task could block until the attach FD closed, while the FD close occurred only in finally.
adversarial_review.repair: Do not await the cancelled blocking read task before finally closes the PTY attach; preserve the prior cancellation/cleanup ordering.
adversarial_review.stale_head_event: main changed terminal_gateway.py after the first branch was created by adding browser input chunking. That stale branch was not fused. The candidate was rebuilt from current main faa4288822b1e5ccb5a4b8aa9c345271ebd1de1f and preserves the chunking delta.
